business_problem: Repsol wanted to help employees reinvent workflows, improve working models, and raise productivity in complex internal processes as part of its broader digitalization program.
solution_summary: Repsol built its own intelligent agent construction platform as a pilot for agent-based AI and multi-agent systems, developed in collaboration with Accenture for the Digitalization and Services department. The platform acts as an orchestration layer where teams can configure AI agents into workflows so the agents can self-organize, coordinate, and perform task groups tied to real departmental processes. To ground those agents in team-specific context, Repsol created large knowledge bases designed exclusively for the teams using the system. It also introduced an interface that adapts language models to a professional, collaborative environment so employees can work with and supervise agent teams rather than use isolated chat interactions. In production use, three teams deployed 22 AI agents, and more than 50 people collaborated with and supervised the agents over more than four months, making the platform a structured internal environment for workflow support and productivity improvement.
